opensearch_anomaly_detection.fit: Good for built-in streaming anomaly baselines close to indexed data.

scikit_learn.fit: Good for offline IsolationForest, OneClassSVM, and calibration experiments on exported datasets.

river.fit: Useful only if streaming online learning is approved and drift cannot be handled by scheduled retraining.

pytorch.fit: Use only if simpler statistical and scikit-learn methods fail approved requirements.
